# tcpshield_firewall_rule (Resource)

An entry in a network's IP firewall. The API has no update for entries, so every change replaces the entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Block a range …
resource "tcpshield_firewall_rule" "block" {
  network_id = tcpshield_network.main.id
  cidr       = "198.51.100.0/24"
}

# … and always let the office through. A single address needs /32.
resource "tcpshield_firewall_rule" "office" {
  network_id = tcpshield_network.main.id
  cidr       = "203.0.113.7/32"
  whitelist  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) CIDR range, e.g. `203.0.113.0/24`; a single address needs `/32`. The API rejects a bare IP (`Invalid Cidr formatting`) and keeps host bits as written. The plan caps the number of entries (Pro: 5, Enterprise: 50) — one past the cap fails at apply.
- `network_id` (Number) Network the entry belongs to.

### Optional

- `whitelist` (Boolean) `true` allows the source, `false` (default) blocks it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric entry id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tcpshield_firewall_rule.block <network_id>/<entry_id>
```
